facts.claim: Each unit price, which the supplier returns as a decimal string, is converted to integer cents per unit and rounded half up once, because the supplier invoices per unit; total_cents is unit_cents times qty. Rounding the line total instead was rejected because it disagrees with the invoice.
Quantities are positive integers; anything else raises ValueError.

A request that names an unknown SKU (one not in the catalog) raises KeyError before the supplier is contacted at all, on every code path that contacts the supplier, because every supplier call is billed and a failed request must cost nothing.
Under contract clause 7 every quote uses the price fetched at the moment of quoting; a price cache was rejected.

QuoteService.quote_many(lines) takes (sku, qty) pairs and returns {"lines": [...], "total_cents": ...}: the quote for each pair in order, in the form quote returns, and the basket total in cents; an empty list returns no lines and a total of 0. The supplier rate-limits requests, so redundant supplier fetches are avoided.

Supplier contract v2 replaces clause 7: a fetched price is guaranteed for 600 seconds. QuoteService takes an optional clock that returns seconds; a price fetched at time t may be reused by quote and quote_many calls made while clock() - t < 600, and must be fetched again after that.
The supplier grants a 5% volume discount: a line of 10 or more units costs 5% less.
SKUs whose catalog shelf_life_days is under 30 are perishable: the supplier reprices them daily, so their prices are never reused. Perishability is decided by shelf life, not by a list of names.
warm(skus) fetches the given SKUs now so later quotes can reuse the prices under the guarantee.
Fetched prices are stored as integer micro-units and accept up to 6 decimal places (more raises ValueError); results stay in integer cents.
QuoteService.quote_orders(orders) takes a list of baskets, each a list of (sku, qty) pairs, and returns the quote_many result for each basket, in order.
The catalog includes flowers with shelf_life_days 5 and frozen_peas with shelf_life_days 180.

forbidden_claims.claim: Prices may be reused across quote calls.
Every quote must fetch a fresh price.
A line or basket total may be rounded instead of each unit price.
A price may be reused at or after 600 seconds, or for a perishable SKU.
The volume discount is taken off the line or basket total.
Perishable SKUs are a fixed list of names.
A path may fetch some SKUs before rejecting a request that names an unknown SKU.
Micro-unit prices are rounded once after multiplying by quantity.
